info.title: ProxCenter public API
info.description: API for external tooling, authenticated by a pxc_ service-account token. Reading and writing depend on the scopes granted to the token. Write operations act on the real infrastructure immediately. Server to server: no CORS header is emitted.

bearerAuth.description: Send the full secret as `Authorization: Bearer pxc_...`.

VmCreateRequest.description: Proxmox create parameters (qm create for qemu, pct create for lxc), forwarded as JSON once the vDC rules have run. A vDC tenant gets its pool and CPU model applied when absent.

pool.description: Resource pool; required for a caller scoped to several pools

VmConfigUpdateRequest.description: Proxmox configuration keys to write. QEMU: name, description, tags, onboot, protection, startup, cores, sockets, cpu, vcpus, cpulimit, cpuunits, numa, memory, balloon, shares, boot, bootdisk, bios, machine, agent, scsihw, vga, ostype, hotplug, tablet, localtime, freeze, kvm, acpi, args, cloud-init keys, netN, scsiN/virtioN/ideN/sataN, unusedN, hostpciN, usbN, ipconfigN, efidiskN, tpmstateN, serialN, audioN, rng0. LXC: hostname, description, tags, onboot, protection, startup, cores, cpulimit, cpuunits, memory, swap, unprivileged, features, netN, unusedN. Other keys are dropped.

digest.description: Config digest the change was prepared on; required to stay current when an optical drive changes

get.summary: List all VMs and containers across visible connections
get.description: Aggregated VM/LXC list with status, usage and config-derived fields (cpuType, scsihw, agentEnabled, bios, ostype, onboot, description, macs) served by default. `ips` merges the addresses pinned in the config with the last known guest agent / LXC addresses from a background index; `staleIps` lists the last known addresses a guest could not re-confirm (stopped, agent down) and `ipIndexWarming` tells that the index is still being built. Pass include=agent to probe the QEMU guest agent on running VMs (about 7x slower).

parameters.name: connId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single connection id

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Set to 'agent' to probe the guest agent on running VMs

post.summary: Create a VM or a container
post.description: Creates a QEMU VM ({type} = qemu) or an LXC container ({type} = lxc) on {node}. The body is the Proxmox create parameter set, forwarded once the vDC rules have run: a vDC tenant gets its pool, CPU policy, storage, network and quota enforced, and an IPAM address injected on managed bridges. Setting a NIC MAC or VLAN as a vDC tenant also needs vm.config.nic.mac / vm.config.nic.vlan, which no scope grants.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Raw connection id; must be inside the token connection perimeter.
